verse.verse_1: By the sky, and by the nightly comer!
verse.verse_2: What could let you know what the nightly comer is!
verse.verse_4: For every soul there is a watcher.
verse.verse_5: Let the human reflect of what he is created.
verse.verse_6: He was created from ejaculated water
verse.verse_7: that issues from between the loins and the ribs.
verse.verse_8: Surely, He is Able to bring him back,
verse.verse_9: on the Day when consciences are examined,
verse.verse_10: when he will be helpless, with no supporter.
verse.verse_11: By the sky with its returning rain,
verse.verse_12: and by the earth bursting with vegetation;
verse.verse_13: this is indeed a Decisive Word,
verse.verse_17: Therefore respite the unbelievers, and delay them for a while.
